login.title: Sign in
login.help: Your counselor gave you your username and password. If you cannot sign in, contact your counselor.
login.intro: After your loss, walk this path step by step, with a counselor and with people who share the same experience.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.intro: The password from your counselor was only for the first sign-in. Before continuing, choose a new one that only you know.
changePassword.currentPasswordHint: The password your counselor gave you

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong username or password. Try again, or contact your counselor if it keeps failing.
errors.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Your account is not active yet. Please contact your counselor.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: You need to change your password before continuing.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.NETWORK: Could not connect. Check your internet and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is taken. Choose another.

validation.passwordCase: Needs upper and lower case letters.
validation.username: Only lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore and dash.

home.title: Telling helps
home.intro: Here you can put your loss into words, name your feelings, and keep your bond with the one you love.

create.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash

password.title: Temporary password
password.note: This password will not be shown again. Pass it on securely; they will be asked to change it at first sign-in.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: Their open sessions end at once and they cannot sign in until reactivated.

reset.title: Reset the password for {{name}}?
reset.body: Their open sessions end. You will need to pass the new temporary password on yourself.

delete.title: Delete {{name}} permanently?
delete.body: Their writing, recordings, images, comments and messages are erased and cannot be recovered. This is only for privacy requests.
